settings.resetAnniversary: Anniversary — resets on each employee's hire anniversary

settings.deductPerHour: Per hour, rounded up — late/early minutes rounded up to whole hours

settings.manageShiftsHint: Manage shifts on the Scheduling page

settings.leavePolicyHint2: Annual leave is pro-rated by hire date for employees under 1 year (rounded up), and granted in full from 1 year.

settings.firstSetupNotice2: Marriage / bereavement / official leave vary widely in practice, so they are left blank for you to set. Every field is editable.

settings.onsiteHint2: Non-on-site days allow remote punching; approved leave days are exempt automatically.
settings.cycleHint: (tick the on-site days for each week)

settings.onsiteUnset: Not configured — remote punching allowed every day
